comparison.objective: Withdraw a pin, tilt an antenna panel and re-pin it at the new downtilt; candidate finishes HELICOIL inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Load-aware pin extraction, articulated-panel positioning and reinsertion versus coaxial mandrel placement, regulated hammer impact and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Panel reaches the new angle, is re-pinned and released; candidate requires four physical fractures, retained inserts and complete tang containment.
comparison.reason: Pin-based reconfiguration and latching are materially different from destructive tang removal with damage and debris controls.
